program:
alphabet 0 1

is_bos = bos
is_sym0 = symbol 0
is_sym1 = symbol 1
h1_1 = rightmost(is_sym0@i & !is_sym1@i & !is_bos@j, is_bos@i & is_sym0@i & is_sym1@i & !is_bos@j & !is_sym0@j & is_sym1@j | is_sym0@i & !is_bos@j & !is_sym0@j & is_sym1@j)
h1_2 = leftmost(is_sym0@i & !is_sym1@i & !is_bos@j | !is_bos@j & is_sym0@j, is_sym0@i & !is_sym1@i & !is_sym0@j | !is_sym0@j & is_sym1@j)
h1_3 = rightmost(is_sym0@i & !is_sym1@i, is_sym0@i & !is_sym1@i & !is_bos@j & !is_sym0@j & is_sym1@j)
h2_1 = rightmost(is_sym0@i & !is_sym1@i & h1_3@i & !is_sym0@j & !h1_1@j | is_sym0@i & !is_sym1@i, is_sym0@i & !is_sym1@i & h1_2@i & h1_3@i & !is_sym0@j & is_sym1@j & !h1_3@j | h1_2@i & h1_3@i & !h1_3@j)
h2_2 = leftmost(!is_bos@j & is_sym0@j & !is_sym1@j & !h1_1@j & !h1_3@j | !h1_1@i & !h1_3@i, !h1_1@j & !h1_3@j | !h1_3@i)
h2_3 = rightmost(!is_bos@j & h1_2@j | !is_bos@j & is_sym0@j & !is_sym1@j, !is_bos@i & !is_bos@j & !h1_1@j & !h1_3@j | !h1_3@i)
accept = is_sym0 & h1_1 & h1_2 & h1_3 & h2_1 & !h2_2 & !h2_3 | is_sym0 & !is_sym1 & h1_2 & h1_3 & !h2_2 & !h2_3

output accept
